**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

This is a delta review of commit `066b5975e`, the one-commit fix for the finding of the review at `6b845e5ef`. I did not re-review the rest of the PR.

## What looks good

- The assert matches the PR's own goldens. `crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs:314` expects `G01 X0. Z12. F0.02`. That is the exact line at `examples/catalog/turning/cone-thread/cone-thread.nc:680` and `examples/catalog/turning/groove-part-off/groove-part-off.nc:101`.
- The change does not weaken the test. The old assert used `starts_with("G01 X0. Z13.5")`, a prefix match. The new one uses `Vec::contains`, a whole-line match, inside the `Part off` section only (`section` returns `Vec<&str>`, `crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs:245`). It is stricter.
- The new comment states the kerf law (plane Z15, the 3 mm kerf Z12..15 on the bar side) and names the issue.
- The delta touches only `crates/app/tests/example_catalog.rs` (+5 -1). It changes no product code.

## Results merged with main

Trial merge with `origin/main` `64b737729`: clean, no conflicts. Ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/pr-3472-rework` (no runner):

- `turning_cone_thread_case_posts_the_taper_and_the_thread` (`camcraft-app`, `example_catalog`, `--exact`): 1 passed, 0 failed.
- `example_catalog` binary (`cargo test -p camcraft-app --test example_catalog`): 37 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored.

Clippy is not re-run for this delta. The change is one test assert, and the author's clippy at `6b845e5ef` is green. No product code changed.

## Heavy lanes

The PR's diff reaches the app and motion heavy lanes. The author ran them on head `6b845e5ef`: 244 steps, 0 failed, 77.5 minutes. This delta changes no product code, so that heavy result stands for the delta. I did not re-run a heavy lane at `066b5975e`.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes

- Not blocking: the delta commit trailer says `Refs #3472` (the PR). `Refs #3452` (the issue) would match the other commits.
- Not blocking: the PR body's gate readings still name `6b845e5ef` as the final head. The body can add the `066b5975e` readings.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
